Under the frozen profile, one-cell mass is \(v\asymp \ell^d\), hence \(nv\lesssim1\iff n\delta^{d/q}\lesssim1\); no \(h^d\) factor belongs there. Instead,
\[
kp_2/n^2\asymp h^d\ell^d
=\delta^{d/\gamma+d/q}.

\[
\varepsilon\gtrsim n^{-2}\delta^{-(1+d/q+d/\gamma)}

under the stated multiplier normalization, with \(D_F=1+d/q+d/\gamma\). Comparing this exponent with the relevant elbow scale \(n^{-q/d}\) yields
\[
-1+\frac qd+\frac q\gamma\le-\frac qd
\iff d\ge 2q+\frac{qd}{\gamma}.
\]
The occupancy formula, privacy exponent, and boundary are therefore algebraically consistent.
